full_prompt_en: A square surreal studio image shows the upper body of a woman in a deep red coat whose head has the carefully modeled form of a young sheep. The background is an uninterrupted, medium warm-gray surface, lighter behind the face than the dark red garment below. The figure occupies the central area and faces left in a strict profile, leaving open gray space in front of her muzzle. At the upper center, brown human hair is swept back and gathered into a loose knot, with stray strands curling behind the neck. From beneath this hair emerges the brown animal head, its long narrow snout extending toward the left edge and its large dark eye looking calmly forward. A broad ear projects horizontally across the upper right side, its rim sharply visible against the plain ground. The animal surface carries finely mottled tan, umber, and gray-brown coloring, with darker marks around the eye, nostril, and mouth. The neck below is smooth and human, a pale warm column that connects the hybrid head to the clothing without any dramatic seam. In the lower half, a structured crimson-red coat has a broad folded collar, dark buttons, and softly gathered fabric along the shoulder. Small dark creases and worn-looking variations interrupt the otherwise rich matte red. The shoulder continues beyond the lower and right frame edges, making the head and collar feel close to the viewer. Gentle studio light comes from the front and upper left, revealing the eye, muzzle, ear, and pale neck with restrained highlights while leaving deeper shadows under the jaw and inside the coat folds. Focus remains even and precise across the central hybrid form, and the plain background offers no objects or readable text. The overall composition is quiet and uncanny, using realistic surface detail, a spare gray field, and a concentrated red accent to make the improbable anatomy feel matter-of-fact.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超现实影棚图像呈现一名身穿深红色外套的女子上半身，她的头部具有经过细致塑造的幼羊形态。背景是一整片不中断的中等暖灰色表面，在面部后方比下方的深红衣物更亮。人物占据画面中央，严格以侧面朝左，让口鼻前方留出开放的灰色空间。上部中央的棕色人类头发向后梳拢，结成松散发髻，零散发丝在颈后弯曲。棕色动物头部从头发下显现，细长口鼻伸向左缘，大而深色的眼睛平静地望向前方。一只宽大的耳朵沿右上方水平伸出，耳缘在朴素底色上清楚可见。动物表面具有细密斑驳的浅棕、深褐和灰褐色，眼周、鼻孔及嘴部附近留有较深痕迹。下方的颈部光滑而属于人类，是一段温暖浅色的长形体块，把混合的头部与衣服连接起来，没有夸张的接缝。下半部一件结构分明的绯红外套带有宽阔翻领、深色纽扣和肩部轻柔收拢的布料。细小深色皱褶与近似磨损的变化打断原本丰厚哑光的红色。肩膀延伸出画面下缘和右缘，使头部及衣领显得靠近观者。柔和影棚光从前方和左上方照来，以克制的高光显出眼睛、口鼻、耳朵和浅色颈部，同时在下颌下方及外套褶缝留下更深阴影。中央混合形体各处都保持均匀而精确的焦点，简洁背景中没有其他物件或可读文字。整体构图安静而诡异，以逼真的表面细节、疏朗灰色底面和集中的红色重音，让不可能的身体结构显得平静自然。
style_prompt_en: The studio image has a restrained, realistic surface treatment applied to an uncanny composite form. Fine mottling, pores, hair strands, and cloth creases remain sharply observed, while the surrounding field is smooth and unbroken. A medium warm gray carries most of the frame, making one concentrated deep crimson area and smaller tan-brown passages more forceful. The central form has clean outer edges but gently blended tonal changes across its rounded surfaces. Soft frontal light reveals texture without harsh glare, and modest shadow beneath projecting parts gives the shape believable volume. The space is shallow and uncluttered, with generous empty area ahead of the main silhouette. Muted neutrals suppress decorative distractions so that the unusual junction of realistic materials becomes the focal point. The overall effect is calm, precise, and quietly disorienting, with surreal invention presented through ordinary photographic clarity.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅影棚图像把克制而写实的表面处理用于一种奇异的复合形体。细密斑驳、毛孔、发丝和布料皱褶都经过清晰观察，周围色域则平滑而不中断。中等暖灰占据画面大部分面积，使一片集中的深绯红以及较小的浅褐色区域更有力度。中央形体的外缘干净，圆润表面的明度变化却柔和衔接。柔软的正面光显出肌理而没有刺眼亮斑，突出部位下方适度的阴影赋予形态可信体积。空间浅而整洁，主要剪影前方留有宽裕空白。低调中性色压住装饰性干扰，让写实材质之间不同寻常的连接成为焦点。整体效果平静、精确而悄然令人迷惑，以寻常的摄影清晰度呈现超现实的创造。
theme_en: A woman in a red coat with a lamb-like head in profile
theme_zh: 身穿红外套、具有羔羊般头部的侧面女子
name: Lucy Glendinning
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
